raw.description:
About Us:

Rootstock Software® is disrupting the ERP space! We are a worldwide provider of cloud ERP on the Salesforce Cloud Platform. When combined with Salesforce CRM, Rootstock Cloud ERP offers manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain organizations a single platform to grow and manage their businesses. Rootstock Cloud ERP is a flexible, modern, and digitally connected system that transforms companies to deliver a more personalized customer experience, efficiently scale operations, and out-service the competition.

Rootstock Software® serves customers throughout North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific and is available exclusively on the Salesforce Platform (Force.com) via the Salesforce AppExchange, the world’s most-popular marketplace for business apps. Organizations now have insight on what is happening or what will happen at each step of the manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain processes.

This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.
Please, no agencies/recruiters.

Summary:

As a Rootstock Sales Development Representative, you will play a foundational role ingenerating new business opportunities and pipeline for our sales team. You will identify criticaldecision-makers within target manufacturing and distribution organizations and qualifyopportunities through outbound calling, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, working closely with anexperienced team of Senior SDRs and Account Executives.

This role pays $90,000–$100,000 OTE with a base salary of $55,000-$65,000, and is compensated based on qualified opportunitiesgenerated, not raw activity volume. Our comp plan rewards outcomes: the meetings andopportunities that actually advance our pipeline, not just calls dialed or appointments booked.This means your success is measured by the quality of what you bring to the pipeline, andpaid accordingly.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their sales career who wants to build a strongfoundation in technology sales, supported by structured onboarding, a modern sales tech stack, andclose coaching from both peers and leadership. You are enthusiastic, competitive, coachable, and hold yourself accountable to your results.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate outbound interest through a consistent daily cadence of calls, emails, and socialtouches (LinkedIn) to prospects within assigned target accounts and territories.
  • Qualify and book meetings that convert into qualified opportunities, in partnership with theAccount Executive team.
  • Use our sales technology stack — Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, ZoomInfo Copilot, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and Claude — to research accounts, execute outreach, and maintain accuratepipeline records.
  • Research target accounts to understand business operations, leadership structure, and painpoints relevant to ERP and manufacturing software buying decisions.
  • Participate in structured onboarding and ongoing coaching from the Director of DemandGeneration and Senior SDR teammates, including weekly one-on-ones and teamstrategy sessions.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives on pipeline handoff, opportunity qualification standards,and account-level strategy.
  • Contribute to team meetings covering pipeline progress, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce in accordance with Rootstock'sCRM standards.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or outbound prospecting role is a plus butnot required.
  • Interest in technology or software sales; ERP or B2B SaaS exposure a plus.Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong research and analytical instincts, with curiosity about how businesses operate.
  • Highly motivated, coachable, and comfortable being measured on outcomes ratherthan activity.
  • A desire to build and grow a long-term career in sales.

This position is commission eligible.

We offer our team members competitive compensation, world-class benefits, work-life balance (flexible schedules, telecommuting, vacation time off), and the opportunity to work alongside an amazing and supportive team!

Rootstock values diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Salary: $90,000 – $100,000 / year

Overview

BerryDunn’s Healthcare Analytics Practice Group (HAPG), Data Management and Strategy (DMS) team is seeking a Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead and deliver complex data management and system technology initiatives. This role requires a blend of strong project management leadership, technical expertise, and Agile delivery capabilities to successfully manage multiple concurrent projects in a hybrid Agile environment.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading technical teams, strong subject-matter expertise in healthcare data and systems, and the ability to operate at the intersection of project management, business analysis, and data engineering collaboration.

Location: This position can be remote within the United States or based in one of BerryDunn’s office locations.

Travel Expectations: Up to 25% travel may be required depending on client needs and project demands.

You Will

  • Engage in discussions with the team, clients, and project sponsors to define project objectives, success criteria, and priorities
  • Lead and deliver multiple concurrent projects using a hybrid Agile (Scrum) and traditional project management approach
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, and delivery roadmaps
  • Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and resources across projects
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and demos
  • Provide technical oversight across the full Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for assigned projects
  • Collaborate with data engineers on data pipelines, warehousing, reporting, and integration solutions
  • Elicit, document, and manage business and system requirements
  • Translate business needs into clear functional and technical specifications
  • Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Perform and oversee SQL-based data analysis, validation, and quality assurance activities
  • Have a strong understanding of the System Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and be able to grasp complex technical topics
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and team members
  • Provide clear, consistent communication and deliver presentations
  • Use Artificial Intelligence tools to enhance productivity and improve project deliverables
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement
  • Keep abreast of the latest trends and technologies in data engineering, healthcare analytics, data science, and AI to ensure BerryDunn remains at the forefront of the industry
  • Ensure all data solutions comply with industry standards, regulations, and security protocols, particularly those specific to healthcare

You Have

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading enterprise data management, data integration, or data analytics technical projects
  • Experience managing projects in Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery environments
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and managing project artifacts, schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource plans
  • Strong background managing system implementation, data engineering, analytics, reporting, data warehousing, or data modernization initiatives
  • Experience with business analysis, requirements elicitation, process mapping, and requirements management
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data analysis concepts sufficient to effectively collaborate with technical teams and validate project deliverables
  • Hands-on experience with managing/administering projects in Jira
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and leadership skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities
  • A team-oriented mindset with a friendly and professional demeanor, coupled with the ability to remain flexible amid changing needs and priorities
  • Ability to work effectively with coworkers and diverse clients through periods of both intense interaction and self-directed work
  • A bachelor's degree in a related field; Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus

We welcome professionals at various experience levels to apply. Level of hire will be commensurate with experience level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, Medicaid, public health, or human services data ecosystems
  • Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM) or PMP
  • Consulting experience in data analytics, integration, or data management engagements
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies and cloud-based data platforms
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and data governance
  • Experience administering an Atlassian (Jira) instance
  • Ability to support teams and clients across multiple time zones, as needed.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $90,000 to $140,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications in excess of the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

Job Description: ASP Program Manager

Fluke Health Solutions · Fluke Biomedical Division · Authorized Service Provider (ASP) Program

Reports to: Global Service Sales Leader · Department: Global Service Sales

Job Summary:

The ASP Program Manager owns the day-to-day health, growth, and performance governance of Fluke Health Solutions' global network of Authorized Service Providers (ASPs) — the third-party partners who deliver calibration, repair, and preventive maintenance service on Fluke Biomedical equipment outside of Fluke's direct service footprint.

This role is responsible for the full partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritizing new markets, qualifying and onboarding new ASPs, managing royalty and product-tier authorization structures, and running the ongoing quarterly/annual performance cadence that keeps the existing network reliable, compliant, and financially sound. The role blends program management, partner relationship management, and data-driven decision-making, and is measured on ASP network revenue growth, service quality/SLA compliance, and royalty revenue integrity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the ASP performance assessment cadence (quarterly, annual, and trigger-based) as defined in the ASP Assessment Standard Work

  • Evaluate and prioritize new ASP markets using country-level revenue/opportunity modeling (install base, net incremental revenue, cannibalization risk)

  • Score and qualify new ASP candidates against the standard qualification scorecard and Phase 1 audit checklist

  • Manage royalty structure selection and reconciliation across the existing ASP portfolio

  • Own product tier authorization decisions (which service categories each ASP is certified to perform) and reassess at each quarterly review

  • Monitor SLA/turnaround-time performance and loaner pool health across all Tier 2/3 escalations

  • Maintain and report on the ASP KPI dashboard (service volume, revenue vs. plan, customer satisfaction, certification status)

  • Lead or coordinate process-improvement initiatives affecting the ASP network (e.g., contract renewal process, onboarding workflow)

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for escalated ASP or end-customer issues involving ASP-delivered service

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in channel/partner management, service operations, or program management — medical device, biomedical, or technical equipment industry strongly preferred

  • Demonstrated experience managing partner performance against SLAs, KPIs, or contractual scorecards

  • Strong financial/analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting revenue models, royalty structures, and ROI/breakeven analysis

  • Excellent relationship management and cross-cultural communication skills, given the global and multi-region nature of the ASP network

  • Proficiency with Excel/spreadsheet-based analysis tools; experience with CRM or partner management platforms a plus

Preferred:

  • Experience with biomedical test equipment, calibration standards (ISO 17025), or quality systems (ISO 9001/13485)

  • Experience running or participating in Kaizen / continuous-improvement events

  • Prior experience managing international distributor, dealer, or service-partner networks

  • Familiarity with royalty or licensing-based partner compensation models

raw.description:
Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world.

Responsibilities:

  1. Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms.
  2. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes.
  3. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks.
  4. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis.
  5. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time.
  6. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations.
  7. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies.
  8. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses.
  9. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus.
  2. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields.
  3. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).
  4. Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting.
  5. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing.
  6. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau).
  7. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases.
  8. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team.
  9. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

raw.description:
Our Company

Amerita

Overview

The Senior Director, Clinical Quality & Accreditation provides enterprise leadership for clinical quality, regulatory compliance, accreditation, clinical standards, and continuous improvement across Amerita. This position establishes and advances programs that promote patient safety, clinical excellence, regulatory compliance, operational consistency, and readiness for accreditation surveys and audits.

The Senior Director partners with clinical, pharmacy, operations, nursing, compliance, sales, and other functional leaders to develop and implement evidence-based standards, policies, procedures, education, auditing, quality improvement initiatives, and performance management processes. This leader serves as a subject matter expert and strategic resource for clinical and quality matters and maintains effective relationships with regulatory and accrediting organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Provides strategic leadership for enterprise-wide clinical quality and performance improvement programs across Amerita
  • Establishes, maintains, and continuously improves clinical standards, policies, procedures, and practices consistent with federal and state regulations, accrediting standards, and applicable professional standards of care
  • Partners with Clinical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, and other leaders to standardize clinical practices and promote consistent delivery of high-quality patient care
  • Identifies clinical and operational risks and develop strategies to mitigate risk and improve patient outcomes
  • Supports the development and implementation of clinical programs for targeted therapies, disease states, and other strategic areas of care
  • Evaluates new and existing products, equipment, technology, and clinical practices related to patient care and make recommendations based on clinical, quality, safety, and operational considerations
  • Leads the development, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of Amerita's Quality Management and Performance Improvement programs
  • Establishes quality metrics, monitoring processes, and reporting mechanisms to assess clinical performance, patient safety, compliance, and operational effectiveness
  • Leads or supports Quality Committee activities, performance improvement projects, and enterprise quality initiatives
  • Oversees the identification, investigation, and resolution of quality incidents and trends, including Quality Incident Reports (QIRs), as appropriate
  • Monitors quality improvement action plans and outcomes and hold appropriate leaders accountable for timely and sustainable resolution
  • Identifies opportunities to improve processes, reduce risk, increase standardization, and improve the patient and provider experience
  • Leverages data and information systems to support measurement, analysis, reporting, and continuous quality improvement
  • Provides strategic oversight of Amerita's accreditation programs and survey readiness activities
  • Interprets accreditation and regulatory standards and translate requirements into actionable policies, procedures, education, monitoring, and operational practices
  • Maintains strong relationships with accreditation organizations, auditors, and other external stakeholders
  • Leads organizational preparation for accreditation surveys, regulatory reviews, and other external audits
  • Partners with Compliance and operational leaders to ensure ongoing adherence to applicable federal, state, regulatory, and accreditation requirements
  • Monitors regulatory and accreditation changes and assess their impact on Amerita operations and clinical practices
  • Ensures appropriate corrective action plans are developed, implemented, monitored, and sustained following audits, surveys, or identified areas of non-compliance
  • Provides leadership for the development, review, revision, implementation, and maintenance of clinical, quality, and operational policies and procedures
  • Develops and maintains enterprise audit tools and monitoring processes to evaluate branch compliance with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation standards, policies, and clinical standards
  • Oversees routine clinical and operational audits and ensure findings are appropriately communicated, addressed, and tracked to completion
  • Partners with branch and regional leadership to improve compliance and strengthen quality performance
  • Identifies trends and systemic issues through audit and quality data and recommend enterprise-level solutions
  • Establishes and oversees clinical, quality, regulatory, accreditation, and CPR+ education programs for applicable employees
  • Partners with Learning & Development, Clinical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, and Sales leaders to ensure education programs address identified needs and organizational priorities
  • Conducts and/or facilitates education for clinical, pharmacy, operations, and sales teams on clinical standards, quality initiatives, accreditation requirements, and relevant clinical topics
  • Promotes a culture of continuous learning, accountability, patient safety, and quality throughout the organization
  • Leads, develops, coaches, and retains a high-performing Clinical Quality and Accreditation team
  • Establishes clear expectations, priorities, performance measures, and accountability for direct reports
  • Provides regular coaching and feedback and identify opportunities to develop team capabilities and future leaders
  • Serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to senior leadership and operational teams on clinical quality, accreditation, compliance, and patient safety matters
  • Builds effective partnerships across departments and regions to drive standardization and enterprise-wide adoption of quality initiatives
  • Provides consultation and support to leaders during significant quality, compliance, audit, or accreditation matters
  • Collaborates with Sales and other commercial teams to support the appropriate communication and positioning of Amerita's clinical programs and capabilities
  • Promotes operating practices that enable teams to work at the top of their license while maintaining quality, compliance, and patient safety
  • Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the Company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, policies and procedures, Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards
  • Maintains a high level of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, attention to detail, and accountability
  • Performs other duties and special projects as assigned by senior leadership
  • Supervisory Responsibility: yes

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or a related healthcare field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Current RN or RPh license in good standing required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive healthcare experience, with significant experience in clinical quality, quality management, patient safety, regulatory compliance, accreditation, clinical operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience with responsibility for quality, clinical, regulatory, accreditation, performance improvement, or related programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading at least one successful healthcare accreditation cycle.
  • Significant experience working with healthcare regulatory and/or accrediting organizations.
  • Home infusion, specialty pharmacy, or other complex healthcare services experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing and implementing enterprise-wide policies, audit programs, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical education programs.
  • Strong knowledge of home infusion clinical operations, quality management, patient safety, regulatory requirements, and accreditation standards.
  • Strong understanding of ACHC, URAC, and other applicable healthcare accreditation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory and accreditation requirements and translate them into practical operational standards.
  • Strong audit, risk assessment, quality improvement, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent leadership, relationship management, coaching, and change management skills.
  • Ability to analyze quality and operational data and use findings to drive measurable improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, clinicians, operational leaders, auditors, and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and complex initiatives in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment.
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and able to work independently while effectively collaborating across functions.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and drive enterprise-wide standardization and accountability.
  • Percentage of Travel: 0-25%
  • Driving Position: No

**To perform this role will require frequently sitting and typing on a keyboard with fingers, and occasionally standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing (stairs/ladders), kneeling, and stooping. The physical requirements will be the ability to push/pull and lift/carry 1-10 lbs**

About our Line of Business

Amerita, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, is a specialty infusion company focused on providing complex pharmaceutical products and clinical services to patients outside of the hospital. Committed to excellent service, our vision is to combine the administrative efficiencies of a large organization with the flexibility, responsiveness, and entrepreneurial spirit of a local provider. For more information, please visit www.ameritaiv.com. Follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn, and X.

USD $150,000.00 - $190,000.00 / Year

raw.excerpt: OverviewGradient, a Geosyntec Company, is seeking a motivated, experienced and resourceful Senior Scientist to work remote out of their home office in Beltsville, MD supporting our Boston, MA office.
raw.description:
Overview

Gradient, a Geosyntec Company, is seeking a motivated, experienced and resourceful Senior Scientist to work remote out of their home office in Beltsville, MD supporting our Boston, MA office. The Senior Scientist will contribute to, lead and develop work in the areas of human health risk, chemical hazard assessment, product safety, and regulatory support. The candidate is expected to work independently and collaboratively with scientists in several disciplines (e.g., toxicology, epidemiology, exposure science, human health risk assessment, industrial hygiene, chemistry, and engineering) and should enjoy fast-paced, technically challenging consulting work. Strong candidates will have experience developing and applying toxicological evidence to support systematic review, weight-of-evidence evaluation, regulatory comment, litigation support, product safety assessments, and human health risk assessment in the fields of environmental, dietary, pharmaceutical, pesticide, occupational, and consumer product toxicology. The successful candidate will also be expected to actively engage in business development, cultivate and expand client relationships, and help develop new opportunities and clients that support the continued growth of Gradient’s risk sciences practice.

Gradient is an environmental and health risk sciences consulting firm specializing in environmental sciences, human and ecological risk sciences, product stewardship, and life sciences. Gradient's scientists have a variety of backgrounds in chemistry, engineering, toxicology, epidemiology, ecotoxicology, medical device and pharmaceuticals, exposure sciences, industrial hygiene, GIS, product safety and liability, and sustainability.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Gradient will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and take responsibility for projects involving toxicology, occupational health, litigation support, regulatory comment, product safety assessments, and site-specific human health risk assessment.
  • Actively engage in business development by identifying opportunities, preparing proposals, building and maintaining client relationships, with the goal of developing an independent client base over time. Collaborate with Gradient and Geosyntec scientists on business development efforts; and specifically help grow our practice in the areas of risk assessment, food/food-contact, pesticides.
  • Qualitatively and quantitatively assess exposure and human health risks from chemicals in the environment and consumer products.
  • Perform analyses including but not limited to systematic reviews, weight-of-evidence evaluations, hazard assessments, dose-response assessments, toxicity value derivation, and preparation of technical tables and summaries.
  • Conduct literature searches and critically review and evaluate toxicology, epidemiology, exposure, and regulatory science studies relevant to chemical safety and human health risk assessment.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with state and federal government programs that develop, implement, or oversee health-based regulations, guidance, standards, and risk assessment frameworks relevant to chemical safety, hazardous waste, environmental health, occupational health, consumer products, and public health protection.
  • Contribute to and oversee the preparation of deliverables (reports, memoranda, proposals, agency comments).
  • Oversee projects of varying scopes and complexity, including establishing technical approach, establishing and meeting budget and deadlines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, integrating input from toxicology, exposure assessment, epidemiology, risk assessment, engineering, and regulatory specialists, and ensuring that deliverables meet client, regulatory, and scientific expectations.

Education and Licensure

  • Bachelor's degree in science field, preferably biological sciences or related field. (required)
  • Advanced degree (g., M.S. or Ph.D.) in toxicology, pharmacology, environmental health, public health, or a related field. (preferred)

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • At least 8 years (10+ preferred) of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication.
  • Strong technical expertise in toxicology, including the ability to critically evaluate toxicological data, interpret dose-response information, and apply findings in human health risk assessment and regulatory contexts.
  • Experience working in and with state and federal agencies, successfully leading projects that require collaboration between a variety of stakeholders. Demonstrated experience with and responsibility for scope, client communications, project deliverables, budget and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of food, consumer or medical products, pharmaceutical, pesticide, chemical, occupational, or environmental regulations, including experience supporting regulatory submissions, agency comments, risk assessments, or compliance-related evaluations.
  • Demonstrated ability, or strong interest, in business development, including preparing proposals, maintaining client relationships, and developing new clients and project opportunities.

This opportunity will be posted for at least five days. Below are the potential compensation ranges that we in good faith believe are applicable for this role at the time of this posting and are only applicable for jobs to be performed in the specified location(s) below. The typical base salary range for this position is just one component of Geosyntec’s total compensation package for employees. Actual compensation will be determined based on education, experience, skill set and location.

Our Company

Amerita

Overview

The Senior Director, Clinical Quality & Accreditation provides enterprise leadership for clinical quality, regulatory compliance, accreditation, clinical standards, and continuous improvement across Amerita. This position establishes and advances programs that promote patient safety, clinical excellence, regulatory compliance, operational consistency, and readiness for accreditation surveys and audits.

The Senior Director partners with clinical, pharmacy, operations, nursing, compliance, sales, and other functional leaders to develop and implement evidence-based standards, policies, procedures, education, auditing, quality improvement initiatives, and performance management processes. This leader serves as a subject matter expert and strategic resource for clinical and quality matters and maintains effective relationships with regulatory and accrediting organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Provides strategic leadership for enterprise-wide clinical quality and performance improvement programs across Amerita
  • Establishes, maintains, and continuously improves clinical standards, policies, procedures, and practices consistent with federal and state regulations, accrediting standards, and applicable professional standards of care
  • Partners with Clinical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, and other leaders to standardize clinical practices and promote consistent delivery of high-quality patient care
  • Identifies clinical and operational risks and develop strategies to mitigate risk and improve patient outcomes
  • Supports the development and implementation of clinical programs for targeted therapies, disease states, and other strategic areas of care
  • Evaluates new and existing products, equipment, technology, and clinical practices related to patient care and make recommendations based on clinical, quality, safety, and operational considerations
  • Leads the development, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of Amerita's Quality Management and Performance Improvement programs
  • Establishes quality metrics, monitoring processes, and reporting mechanisms to assess clinical performance, patient safety, compliance, and operational effectiveness
  • Leads or supports Quality Committee activities, performance improvement projects, and enterprise quality initiatives
  • Oversees the identification, investigation, and resolution of quality incidents and trends, including Quality Incident Reports (QIRs), as appropriate
  • Monitors quality improvement action plans and outcomes and hold appropriate leaders accountable for timely and sustainable resolution
  • Identifies opportunities to improve processes, reduce risk, increase standardization, and improve the patient and provider experience
  • Leverages data and information systems to support measurement, analysis, reporting, and continuous quality improvement
  • Provides strategic oversight of Amerita's accreditation programs and survey readiness activities
  • Interprets accreditation and regulatory standards and translate requirements into actionable policies, procedures, education, monitoring, and operational practices
  • Maintains strong relationships with accreditation organizations, auditors, and other external stakeholders
  • Leads organizational preparation for accreditation surveys, regulatory reviews, and other external audits
  • Partners with Compliance and operational leaders to ensure ongoing adherence to applicable federal, state, regulatory, and accreditation requirements
  • Monitors regulatory and accreditation changes and assess their impact on Amerita operations and clinical practices
  • Ensures appropriate corrective action plans are developed, implemented, monitored, and sustained following audits, surveys, or identified areas of non-compliance
  • Provides leadership for the development, review, revision, implementation, and maintenance of clinical, quality, and operational policies and procedures
  • Develops and maintains enterprise audit tools and monitoring processes to evaluate branch compliance with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation standards, policies, and clinical standards
  • Oversees routine clinical and operational audits and ensure findings are appropriately communicated, addressed, and tracked to completion
  • Partners with branch and regional leadership to improve compliance and strengthen quality performance
  • Identifies trends and systemic issues through audit and quality data and recommend enterprise-level solutions
  • Establishes and oversees clinical, quality, regulatory, accreditation, and CPR+ education programs for applicable employees
  • Partners with Learning & Development, Clinical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, and Sales leaders to ensure education programs address identified needs and organizational priorities
  • Conducts and/or facilitates education for clinical, pharmacy, operations, and sales teams on clinical standards, quality initiatives, accreditation requirements, and relevant clinical topics
  • Promotes a culture of continuous learning, accountability, patient safety, and quality throughout the organization
  • Leads, develops, coaches, and retains a high-performing Clinical Quality and Accreditation team
  • Establishes clear expectations, priorities, performance measures, and accountability for direct reports
  • Provides regular coaching and feedback and identify opportunities to develop team capabilities and future leaders
  • Serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to senior leadership and operational teams on clinical quality, accreditation, compliance, and patient safety matters
  • Builds effective partnerships across departments and regions to drive standardization and enterprise-wide adoption of quality initiatives
  • Provides consultation and support to leaders during significant quality, compliance, audit, or accreditation matters
  • Collaborates with Sales and other commercial teams to support the appropriate communication and positioning of Amerita's clinical programs and capabilities
  • Promotes operating practices that enable teams to work at the top of their license while maintaining quality, compliance, and patient safety
  • Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the Company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, policies and procedures, Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards
  • Maintains a high level of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, attention to detail, and accountability
  • Performs other duties and special projects as assigned by senior leadership
  • Supervisory Responsibility: yes

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or a related healthcare field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Current RN or RPh license in good standing required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive healthcare experience, with significant experience in clinical quality, quality management, patient safety, regulatory compliance, accreditation, clinical operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience with responsibility for quality, clinical, regulatory, accreditation, performance improvement, or related programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading at least one successful healthcare accreditation cycle.
  • Significant experience working with healthcare regulatory and/or accrediting organizations.
  • Home infusion, specialty pharmacy, or other complex healthcare services experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing and implementing enterprise-wide policies, audit programs, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical education programs.
  • Strong knowledge of home infusion clinical operations, quality management, patient safety, regulatory requirements, and accreditation standards.
  • Strong understanding of ACHC, URAC, and other applicable healthcare accreditation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory and accreditation requirements and translate them into practical operational standards.
  • Strong audit, risk assessment, quality improvement, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent leadership, relationship management, coaching, and change management skills.
  • Ability to analyze quality and operational data and use findings to drive measurable improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, clinicians, operational leaders, auditors, and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and complex initiatives in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment.
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and able to work independently while effectively collaborating across functions.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and drive enterprise-wide standardization and accountability.
  • Percentage of Travel: 0-25%
  • Driving Position: No

**To perform this role will require frequently sitting and typing on a keyboard with fingers, and occasionally standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing (stairs/ladders), kneeling, and stooping. The physical requirements will be the ability to push/pull and lift/carry 1-10 lbs**

Amerita, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, is a specialty infusion company focused on providing complex pharmaceutical products and clinical services to patients outside of the hospital. Are you interested in driving customer and developer experience for next generation cloud services?

Do you enjoy creating products that customers love?

Come join our Cloud Technology Group!

Akamai is transforming cloud computing with a distributed platform built for developers, startups, and enterprises needing scalable, secure, high-performance infrastructure. With our Cloud launch, we're redefining edge and cloud computing to power modern applications. Our mission, make cloud computing accessible, fast, and secure for every developer, everywhere.

Partner with the best

In this role, you'll help define and execute our cloud market strategy. Partnering across engineering, GTM, and executive teams to build competitive cloud products and leading cross-functional teams. You'll bring deep infrastructure and cloud platform expertise to help engage credibly in customer discussions and technical architecture reviews.

As a Vice President Product Management IaaS, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning product vision and multi-year strategy for our infrastructure as a service (Iaas) portfolio, aligning to our broader cloud growth objectives.
  • Building and leading a high-performing team of product leaders, driving accountability, execution discipline, and a culture of customer obsession.
  • Leading cross-functional execution across product, engineering, and SRE, ensuring alignment and delivery against roadmap priorities.
  • Partnering with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to bring products from concept to launch and scale adoption.
  • Leveraging deep market, customer, and industry insights to identify differentiation opportunities and shape product positioning.
  • Owning business outcomes across your portfolio, including revenue growth, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborating with go-to-market leadership on pricing, packaging, and segment strategy, and representing Akamai externally with customers, partners, and analysts.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Possess 15 years of product management experience in cloud, compute, or infrastructure domains; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Have a successful track record of building and scaling product management organizations, including hiring, mentoring, and establishing effective operating rhythms.
  • Have experience defining and executing product strategy at a senior level, including vision setting, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution.
  • Possess deep fluency in cloud computing concepts, including compute, virtualization, containerization, storage, networking, and managed services.
  • Have experience launching and scaling products successfully, with the ability to articulate outcomes, lessons learned, and areas for improvement.

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Learn more

Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary for this position ranges from $228,600 - $411,400/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

raw.description:
Overview

Gradient, a Geosyntec Company, is seeking a motivated, experienced and resourceful Senior Scientist to work remote out of their home office in Beltsville, MD supporting our Boston, MA office. The Senior Scientist will contribute to, lead and develop work in the areas of human health risk, chemical hazard assessment, product safety, and regulatory support. The candidate is expected to work independently and collaboratively with scientists in several disciplines (e.g., toxicology, epidemiology, exposure science, human health risk assessment, industrial hygiene, chemistry, and engineering) and should enjoy fast-paced, technically challenging consulting work. Strong candidates will have experience developing and applying toxicological evidence to support systematic review, weight-of-evidence evaluation, regulatory comment, litigation support, product safety assessments, and human health risk assessment in the fields of environmental, dietary, pharmaceutical, pesticide, occupational, and consumer product toxicology. The successful candidate will also be expected to actively engage in business development, cultivate and expand client relationships, and help develop new opportunities and clients that support the continued growth of Gradient’s risk sciences practice.

Gradient is an environmental and health risk sciences consulting firm specializing in environmental sciences, human and ecological risk sciences, product stewardship, and life sciences. Gradient's scientists have a variety of backgrounds in chemistry, engineering, toxicology, epidemiology, ecotoxicology, medical device and pharmaceuticals, exposure sciences, industrial hygiene, GIS, product safety and liability, and sustainability.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Gradient will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and take responsibility for projects involving toxicology, occupational health, litigation support, regulatory comment, product safety assessments, and site-specific human health risk assessment.
  • Actively engage in business development by identifying opportunities, preparing proposals, building and maintaining client relationships, with the goal of developing an independent client base over time. Collaborate with Gradient and Geosyntec scientists on business development efforts; and specifically help grow our practice in the areas of risk assessment, food/food-contact, pesticides.
  • Qualitatively and quantitatively assess exposure and human health risks from chemicals in the environment and consumer products.
  • Perform analyses including but not limited to systematic reviews, weight-of-evidence evaluations, hazard assessments, dose-response assessments, toxicity value derivation, and preparation of technical tables and summaries.
  • Conduct literature searches and critically review and evaluate toxicology, epidemiology, exposure, and regulatory science studies relevant to chemical safety and human health risk assessment.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with state and federal government programs that develop, implement, or oversee health-based regulations, guidance, standards, and risk assessment frameworks relevant to chemical safety, hazardous waste, environmental health, occupational health, consumer products, and public health protection.
  • Contribute to and oversee the preparation of deliverables (reports, memoranda, proposals, agency comments).
  • Oversee projects of varying scopes and complexity, including establishing technical approach, establishing and meeting budget and deadlines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, integrating input from toxicology, exposure assessment, epidemiology, risk assessment, engineering, and regulatory specialists, and ensuring that deliverables meet client, regulatory, and scientific expectations.

Education and Licensure

  • Bachelor's degree in science field, preferably biological sciences or related field. (required)
  • Advanced degree (g., M.S. or Ph.D.) in toxicology, pharmacology, environmental health, public health, or a related field. (preferred)

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • At least 8 years (10+ preferred) of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication.
  • Strong technical expertise in toxicology, including the ability to critically evaluate toxicological data, interpret dose-response information, and apply findings in human health risk assessment and regulatory contexts.
  • Experience working in and with state and federal agencies, successfully leading projects that require collaboration between a variety of stakeholders. Demonstrated experience with and responsibility for scope, client communications, project deliverables, budget and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of food, consumer or medical products, pharmaceutical, pesticide, chemical, occupational, or environmental regulations, including experience supporting regulatory submissions, agency comments, risk assessments, or compliance-related evaluations.
  • Demonstrated ability, or strong interest, in business development, including preparing proposals, maintaining client relationships, and developing new clients and project opportunities.

This opportunity will be posted for at least five days. The typical base salary range for this position is just one component of Geosyntec’s total compensation package for employees. Actual compensation will be determined based on education, experience, skill set and location.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including, paid holidays, vacation, sick, and personal paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and other benefits to eligible employees.

raw.excerpt: The VP, Data Engineering is a senior executive role responsible for defining and executing enterprise-wide data and respective AI strategy.
raw.description:
The VP, Data Engineering is a senior executive role responsible for defining and executing enterprise-wide data and respective AI strategy. This leader owns the transformation of data into a strategic asset that drives operational excellence, enables real-time decision-making, and unlocking new revenue streams through advanced analytics and data monetization. The role is accountable for the full lifecycle of data across the organization, including data architecture, governance, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and AI enablement, spanning all business units including BPO operations, marketing services, fulfillment, logistics and lead generation.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, this role will lead the evolution from traditional reporting and business intelligence into a modern, scalable, and self-service analytics ecosystem powered by Microsoft Fabric. A core mandate is to establish a governed, business-friendly data environment where leaders can independently access insights, reducing dependency on technical teams while maintaining data integrity and consistency. This includes building reusable semantic models, standardized KPIs, and intuitive dashboards that drive adoption across finance, operations, HR, marketing, and client-facing teams.

This role will also be responsible for embedding advanced analytics and AI into the business, enabling predictive and prescriptive capabilities such as customer behavior modeling, workforce optimization, lead scoring, and operational forecasting. This leader will work closely with executive stakeholders to ensure that insights are not only generated but operationalized and that translates data into measurable business outcomes such as cost reduction, revenue growth, and improved client experience.

The ideal candidate will bring 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in data, analytics, or AI, with a proven track record of transforming organizations from traditional BI environments into advanced, insight-driven enterprises. This individual 1 must possess deep expertise in modern data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar), strong business acumen, and the ability to lead organizational change. Equally important is the ability to communicate complex data concepts in a clear and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to build strong partnerships across the enterprise.

This role requires a forward-thinking leader who combines strategic vision with hands on execution, capable of building high-performing teams and fostering a culture where data is trusted, accessible, and central to every key decision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute an enterprise-wide data, analytics, and AI strategy aligned to the organization's multi-business operating model
  • Transform data into a strategic asset that drives decision-making, operational efficiency, and revenue growth
  • Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the enterprise data platform leveraging Microsoft Fabric, enabling scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions
  • Establish a governed self-service analytics environment, reducing reliance on technical teams while empowering business users with intuitive dashboards and insights
  • Drive the transition from descriptive and diagnostic reporting to predictive and prescriptive analytics across all business functions
  • Embed advanced analytics and AI capabilities into core operations, including workforce optimization, customer experience, marketing performance, lead generation, and logistics
  • Develop and implement data monetization strategies, identifying opportunities to create revenue-generating data products and client-facing analytics solutions
  • Partner with operational, client and sales teams to integrate insights into client offerings and enhance competitive differentiation
  • Standardize enterprise KPIs and reporting frameworks to ensure a single source of truth across finance, HR, operations, and commercial teams
  • Improve speed to insight by enabling real-time or near real-time reporting and automated decision-support tools
  • Establish and enforce data governance, data quality, and master data management practices while maintaining agility and accessibility
  • Define data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across business units 2
  • Lead and scale multidisciplinary teams across business intelligence, data engineering, and data science
  • Evolve team capabilities from report development to data product creation and advanced analytics delivery
  • Drive cross-functional data integration across BPO operations, marketing services, fulfillment, logistics, and lead generation to enable end-to-end visibility and insights
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to translate business strategy into data-driven initiatives and measurable outcomes
  • Foster a data-driven culture by improving data literacy, adoption of analytics tools, and accountability for data-informed decision-making across the organization

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field required; or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or AI, with at least 5+ years in a senior or executive leadership role
  • Proven track record of transforming organizations from traditional reporting environments into advanced analytics and AI-driven enterprises
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing modern data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar)
  • Strong experience enabling self-service analytics and building scalable semantic models, data products, and governed BI environments
  • Experience developing and executing data monetization strategies or leveraging analytics to drive measurable revenue growth
  • Deep understanding of data governance, data quality, master data management, and enterprise data architecture principles
  • Hands-on experience with advanced analytics, including predictive modeling, prescriptive analytics, and AI/ML applications in business environments
  • Experience working across complex, multi-business or multi-industry organizations; exposure to BPO, customer experience, marketing services, logistics, or lead generation is highly preferred
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate data insights into business value and strategic outcomes
  • Proven ability to lead and scale high-performing, cross-functional teams across data engineering, BI, and data science disciplines
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executive leadership and clearly articulate complex concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change, driving adoption of new technologies, and fostering a data-driven culture
  • Experience integrating data across acquisitions or disparate systems is highly desirable
  • High level of proficiency with modern analytics tools and ecosystems, including Power BI, SQL, and cloud-based data services
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, and regulatory considerations related to data management (preferably SOC2, PCI & ISO27001)

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.


As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Trial Manager to join our diverse and dynamic team at ICON Plc. In this critical role, you will be responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and successful completion of clinical trials, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and regulatory guidelines. As a leader in our research department, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage site relationships, and provide strategic guidance to drive the successful delivery of clinical trial outcomes.


What You Will Do:

Your focus will be on coordinating clinical trial management delivery, resolving issues, and developing team capability.

Key responsibilities include:


  • Budget Oversight Oversee the clinical portion of the budget to ensure efficient resource allocation.
  • Ensuring Effective Study Oversight: Develop monitoring plans and tools, ensuring effective study oversight.
  • Optimizing Performance: Train and mentor Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) to optimize their performance.

  • Improving Study Integrity Review trip reports and implement corrective and preventative action plans when necessary. Building Productive Relationships: Foster productive relationships with Sponsors, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

Your Profile:

You will have solid clinical trial management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required qualifications and experience:

  • A minimum of 4+ years of experience in a Clinical Trial Management position at a CRO or Pharmaceutical Organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in health, life sciences, or other relevant fields of study.
  • At least 10+ years of relevant experience in clinical trial management.
  • Preferred: 2+ years of monitoring experience.
  • Experience supporting complex protocols, including areas such as MASH/NASH, Radiopharmaceutical, or other specialized therapeutic programs, is highly valued.
  • Experience in managing complex or global trials is advantageous.
  • Preferred: Experience in managing all trial components from start-up to database lock.
  • This role is intended for experienced CTM professionals; entry-level CTM experience alone will not meet the requirements.
  • Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%).


Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

About the Role:

MedSchoolCoach Medical School Tutoring is committed to providing an exceptional and individualized experience to each and every student. Our tutors provide outstanding tutoring and are always striving to identify better ways to teach, advise, and guide students on their journey through medical school. Every tutor at MedSchoolCoach has robust teaching experience, has scored exceptionally well on their exams, and has a passion for learning, educating, and helping others succeed.

In addition to providing students with an unparalleled learning experience, MedSchoolCoach is committed to providing their tutors with a supportive environment where they can have fun, excel as teachers, and constantly improve their ability to educate.

Tutoring is conducted online from the comfort of your home, school, or office. Scheduling is flexible! We are always looking to add new passionate members to our team, and we look forward to receiving your application.

Qualifications:

COMLEX Successful candidate profile

  • Have passed Level 1, scored ≥ 650 on COMLEX Level 2 and/or 3
  • Have a passion for education and a commitment to student success
  • Be responsible, prompt, and professional
  • Have extensive teaching experience
  • Be available to tutor for an average of at least 5 hours a week
  • Are interested in tutoring for at least 1 year
  • Medical students or residents taking gap years or pursuing advanced degrees (MS, MPH, Ph.D., etc) are encouraged to apply

About MedSchoolCoach:

MedSchoolCoach is a rapidly growing EdTech company that serves the needs of future physicians by providing the highest quality content, tutoring, and advising services. Physician-led and founded, MedSchoolCoach is driven by its mission to help shape the future of medicine. Over time, the organization has become one of the largest players in the medical space, reaching nearly 50% of prospective medical students every year through one of our products or services.

As an organization, MedSchoolCoach stays true to its humble roots while continuing to scale adding more products and services on a continuing basis. MedSchoolCoach was recently named to Inc Magazine’s Inc 5000 list with an overall ranking of 953 and was designated as the 17th fastest growing education company in the United States. We are grounded in our desire to offer prospective doctors with the tools they need to succeed while providing an exceptional learning and mentoring experience. Our vision is to create the most engaging and effective EdTech platform supported by world class physicians and educators for students from all walks of life

Working for MedSchoolCoach:We are a distributed team of creative, approachable, and motivated entrepreneurs, educators, tutors, advisors, and clinicians who are passionate about improving healthcare and education. At MedSchoolCoach, we value problem solvers who take initiative, communicate earnestly, work effectively, and prioritize life-work balance. We do everything we can to make sure our teammates are successful personally and professionally. We welcome all employee contributions in whatever shape or form they manifest, especially as our organization continues to grow.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible schedule—we expect greatness, but will not micromanage your day
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Chance to make a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys

Our client, a well-established multinational D2C e-commerce company operating in the USA, is looking for a highly organized and professional Business Analyst to join their dynamic e-commerce company for a full-time remote job.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect data, analyze it, document processes, and maintain and update reports.
  • Study current processes in the department/company, identify processes and issues that need improvement, and propose enhancements. Implement the improvement process.
  • Create reports necessary for improving inventory management, marketing activities, and pricing, as well as optimizing logistics and inventory costs.
  • Analyze and forecast sales, and predict demand for new directions.
  • Monitor key performance indicators for the purchasing department in the company.
  • Prepare presentations using graphs and charts.

Skills:

Analytical thinking - working with large databases, which requires collecting, analyzing, classifying, diagnosing problems, and proposing solutions.

Attention to detail.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets.

Experience in retail e-commerce (Amazon, Shopify) is an advantage.

Communication skills.

Organizational skills - a strategic approach to task execution, proper prioritization, and time management.

English language proficiency at B2 level.

Tasks:

Study the business processes of the purchasing department.

Work on creating a new inventory management system in the purchasing department based on the current report, breaking it down into different files according to business logic and operational efficiency, considering the needs of company employees.

Analyze the production time of goods and their readiness (early or delayed production) to correctly determine the "safety stock/target level" and reorder point.

Regularly analyze the delivery times of goods from the supplier to the prep center, and from the prep center to the Amazon warehouse.

Analyze costs (advertising, marketing, logistics, additional costs (Amazon fees) per unit of product) to determine the minimum profit and/or minimum number of units that need to be sold for this operational activity to be profitable for the company.

Our benefits:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities
  • Supportive work environment
  • Friendly International start-up environment

raw.title: Scrum Master (Information Technology/Software/Remote)
raw.excerpt: Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc).
raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.
