Job Title: Remote Virtual Prenatal Coach / Pregnancy Wellness Specialist

Company Overview:

Evolution Sports Group is a leading provider of virtual health and wellness services, dedicated to helping individuals achieve their fitness and wellness goals. Our team of experienced coaches and specialists are committed to providing personalized and effective support to our clients, using the latest technology and techniques.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Remote Virtual Prenatal Coach / Pregnancy Wellness Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with expecting mothers to provide personalized coaching and support throughout their pregnancy journey. You will be responsible for creating customized fitness and wellness plans, conducting virtual coaching sessions, and providing ongoing support and guidance to help our clients maintain a healthy and active lifestyle during pregnancy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct virtual consultations with expecting mothers to assess their fitness and wellness goals and create personalized plans to support their pregnancy journey.
  • Develop customized fitness and nutrition plans that are safe and effective for pregnant women, taking into consideration any pre-existing medical conditions or complications.
  • Conduct virtual coaching sessions to guide and support clients in their fitness and wellness routines, providing modifications and adjustments as needed.
  • Monitor and track client progress, adjusting plans and goals as necessary.
  • Provide ongoing support and guidance to clients, answering any questions and addressing any concerns they may have throughout their pregnancy.
  • Keep up-to-date with the latest research and recommendations in prenatal fitness and wellness to ensure the highest level of support for clients.
  • Collaborate with other coaches and specialists within the company to provide a comprehensive and holistic approach to prenatal wellness.

Qualifications:

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in exercise science, kinesiology, or a related field.
  • Certification in prenatal fitness or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working as a prenatal coach or pregnancy wellness specialist.
  • Strong knowledge of prenatal fitness and wellness, including exercise modifications and nutrition recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients.
  • Experience conducting virtual coaching sessions and using virtual platforms for communication and tracking progress.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple clients and tasks simultaneously.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

SUMMARY:

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Sourcing Manager to lead sourcing, supplier management, and contract negotiations across technology and professional services categories for a temporary staffing and workforce solutions organization. This role will be responsible for developing sourcing strategies, optimizing supplier performance, negotiating favorable commercial terms, and driving cost savings while ensuring quality, compliance, and business continuity.

The ideal candidate combines strong procurement expertise with exceptional stakeholder management skills and experience managing complex supplier relationships in technology, consulting, professional services, and contingent workforce environments.

Location: Remote (West Coast candidates preferred)

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for technology and professional services spend categories, including software, SaaS, IT services, consulting, managed services, telecommunications, and business services.
  • Conduct spend analysis, market research, and supplier assessments to identify sourcing opportunities and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Lead competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and supplier evaluations.
  • Build category strategies that align with organizational goals, operational requirements, and growth objectives.

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers and service providers.
  • Evaluate supplier performance through defined KPIs, scorecards, and business reviews.
  • Identify and mitigate supplier risks related to financial stability, service delivery, security, compliance, and business continuity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives with key suppliers to enhance value and service quality.

Contract Negotiation & Management

  • Lead commercial negotiations for supplier agreements, statements of work, master service agreements, software licensing agreements, and professional services contracts.
  • Negotiate pricing, service-level agreements (SLAs), payment terms, renewal provisions, data security requirements, and contractual protections.
  • Partner with legal, finance, IT, and business stakeholders throughout the contracting lifecycle.
  • Ensure contracts are properly documented, maintained, and compliant with company policies.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate with department leaders to understand business requirements and sourcing needs.
  • Provide procurement guidance and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and vendor selection decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on sourcing best practices and supplier management strategies.

Cost Savings & Value Creation

  • Identify and execute cost reduction, cost avoidance, and value-generation initiatives.
  • Track sourcing project outcomes and report savings achievements.
  • Drive process improvements that increase procurement efficiency and supplier effectiveness.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Procurement, or related field.
  • 7+ years of strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management experience.
  • Experience sourcing and negotiating contracts within technology and professional services categories.
  • Demonstrated success leading supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost savings.
  • Strong understanding of contract terms, commercial negotiations, and supplier management principles.
  • Experience managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships.
  • Advanced analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in staffing, workforce solutions, human capital, or professional services industries.
  • Experience sourcing technology solutions including SaaS, cloud services, software licensing, cybersecurity, and IT consulting.
  • Professional certification such as CPSM, CPSD, CSCP, CPM, or equivalent.

CORE KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS:

  • Ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders to support proposed strategies, process improvements and operational decisions.
  • Critical thinker with resourcefulness and ability to devise and create and communicate timely solutions to medium-to-complex problems.
  • Strong multi-tasker with ability to prioritize and adapt fast in an ever-changing environment
  • Effectively manage numerous projects at a given time in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to think creatively, work independently and as part of a team to solve problems given limited resources and time and, have a strong work ethic, and adhere to deadlines.
  • Solid organizational and project management skills
  • Results oriented
  • Ability to effectively interact and communicate with all levels of management to build partnerships with various departments and suppliers
  • Experience performing cost savings analysis using advanced Excel including V-look ups, pivot tables, and other related software applications
  • Experience with procurement, contract lifecycle management, or spend analytics systems (Oracle Fusion).

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position will not have any direct supervisory responsibilities.

Salary Range: $124,300 – $155,300 annually, depending on experience and geographic location plus eligibility for an annual bonus, subject to plan terms.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements, and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

Benefits and Well-Being:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here.

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at , or 1-800-610-8920. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.

About Augintel: We exist to give child welfare leadership and staff a deeper understanding of the people they care for. By building SaaS software applications that apply cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques, we help clinicians in social services, behavioral health and child welfare – government, private and nonprofit – unlock the value of their unstructured data to improve their understanding, save them time, and help them deliver better outcomes to the people and communities they serve.

Location: Remote (US). Ability to support customers across multiple time zones is required.

Job Summary:

Over the last six years Augintel has built a new category in Child Welfare and has transformed how caseworkers and supervisors do their jobs. We’ve been first to market with an industry-defining product, enjoy exceptional customer retention, and continue to win new business. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need to strengthen both our strategic vision as well as our day-to-day execution.

The Chief Product Officer will be the executive responsible for aligning Augintel’s strategy and product direction and associated operating cadence and cross-functional execution.

This leader will help Augintel maintain the speed and customer intimacy of a founder-led company while building the clarity, accountability, prioritization discipline, and operating infrastructure required for sustainable growth.

At the product level, this leader will own the translation of Augintel’s vision into a cohesive 12–36 month product strategy and roadmap. They will ensure that new products and features do not simply ship, but land in the market with clear positioning, customer value, adoption plans, enablement, and measurable revenue impact.

At the operating level, this leader will build the company-wide rhythms that connect annual strategy to quarterly execution, commitments to operating plans, and customer commitments to product, engineering, and commercial capacity.

The right person is both strategic and hands-on. They can articulate a compelling multi-year product vision, but they also care deeply about roadmap discipline, prioritization, launch quality, customer feedback loops, commercial enablement, financial outcomes, and execution predictability.

The ideal candidate thrives in founder-led organizations transitioning from early-stage success to operational maturity. They excel at balancing customer commitments with long-term strategic investments and are energized by solving complex scaling challenges.

This is a role for a builder, operator, product strategist, and trusted CEO partner. This role is part of the executive team and reports to the CEO.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Operating Rhythm & Execution

  • Translate annual strategic product objectives into measurable quarterly execution
  • Lead company-wide planning processes, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and operating reviews
  • Establish and maintain a consistent cadence of product and go-to-market execution and accountability across the organization
  • Monitor progress against company objectives and proactively identify execution risks

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own Augintel’s product strategy in partnership with the CEO, Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Customer Impact
  • Translate CEO vision and market insight into a cohesive 12–36 month product roadmap
  • Balance near-term customer commitments with long-term strategic product investments
  • Ensure roadmap decisions are grounded in customer value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and time-to-market
  • Establish clear prioritization frameworks that guide what Augintel starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes
  • Elevate product discovery, customer understanding, design discipline, experimentation, and product decision-making across the company
  • Represent Product at the executive and board level with clarity, structure, and strategic insight

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Facilitate product alignment on priorities, trade-offs, and resource allocation
  • Drive resolution of cross-functional issues that impede execution
  • Foster a culture of transparency, constructive debate, and shared ownership

Strategic Portfolio Management

  • Partner with executive leadership to balance customer commitments, innovation initiatives, and operational investments
  • Establish frameworks for prioritization and governance
  • Ensure product investment decisions align with strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes
  • Drive disciplined decision-making around what the organization starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes

Growth & Commercial Excellence

  • Partner with Revenue, Marketing and Customer Success leaders to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the commercial engine
  • Partner with Customer Success Team to identify opportunities to accelerate time-to-value, improve expansion outcomes, and increase customer retention
  • Partner with Customer Success, Revenue and Marketing to ensure customer insights, adoption trends, and implementation learnings inform company strategy, product priorities, and operational improvements
  • Support enterprise deal strategy where cross-functional leadership is required

Organizational Scale & Effectiveness

  • Design and evolve product operating mechanisms appropriate for the company's stage of growth
  • Clarify product and roadmap related decision rights, ownership models, and escalation paths
  • Develop scalable product management processes that increase organizational effectiveness without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy

Metrics & Performance Management

  • Define and monitor the critical metrics that drive performance
  • Use data to identify emerging risks and opportunities
  • Ensure the organization focuses on outcomes rather than activity

CEO Partnership

  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO
  • Drive follow-through on strategic product initiatives and board commitments
  • Prepare materials and insights related to product, roadmap and the market for executive and board discussions

Augintel is proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to a stronger workplace and a better product for our users. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to join us in transforming how human services agencies support children, families, and communities.

raw.description:
Job Title: Senior Director, R&D Capability Enablement

Job Location: Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Director, R&D Capability Enablement

What you will do


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will translate R&D strategy into learning experiences, role readiness, and development opportunities that build workforce capability across R&D. In partnership with R&D leaders and functional learning partners, the role defines how priority capabilities are built, designs the experiences that enable them, and prepares employees to perform successfully. 

Working with R&D leaders and subject matter experts, the Senior Director translates business priorities into learning experiences and content that is accurate, useful, and easy to find. The role leads instructional designers, establishes content creation standards and a content management strategy, and uses learning analytics to show leaders what is working, where capability gaps remain, and where to focus investment. 


What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.


Key Responsibilities

Capability Strategy & Needs 

  • Partner with R&D leaders to identify current and emerging capability needs tied to scientific priorities, operating plans, and workforce plans. 
  • Use colleague feedback, capability assessments, performance data, and business priorities to identify gaps and sequence learning investments. 
  • Maintain a rolling capability roadmap and review it with R&D leadership at least twice a year. 

Learning Experience & Instructional Design Leadership 

  • Lead and develop instructional designers, set portfolio priorities, allocate work, and coach the team on learning design and delivery. 
  • Design role-based learning journeys and pathways, using a 70/20/10 approach where appropriate and drawing on instructor-led, digital, experiential, and coached learning. 
  • Create curricula and end-to-end learning experiences for priority capabilities, including instructional design, content development, and facilitation in partnership with subject matter experts. 

R&D Capability Architecture & Framework 

  • Translate leadership-defined R&D priorities into a shared capability architecture and framework, including core capabilities and proficiency expectations. 
  • Partner with leaders across R&D functions, including clinical development, data science, translational science, and research, to align priorities and provide guidance on competencies for critical roles. 
  • Translate the framework into role-based learning architecture, journeys, pathways, and manager resources that functions can use in their day-to-day work. 
  • Use feedback from learners and leaders, along with capability data, to update the framework as R&D needs change. 

Performance Readiness 

  • Oversee training governance, training management, and assignment processes for learning owned by Capability Enablement, with clear roles and standards. 
  • Develop end-to-end process learning for priority R&D workflows, partnering with process owners and functional teams on local learning needs. 
  • Define readiness expectations for priority functions and critical roles, and use appropriate checks to understand whether employees can perform required work. 

Advanced Capability Programs 

  • Design targeted programs for future-potential and high-potential R&D talent, including internships, rotations, mentorship, and focused development opportunities. 
  • Develop capability academies for priority R&D needs, such as AI application, when they address a defined business need. 
  • Focus these programs on targeted capability acceleration that complements Enterprise talent development and avoids duplicating existing programs. 

Learning Analytics & Business Impact 

  • Define measures for each learning goal, including reach, engagement, capability gains, application on the job, and relevant business outcomes. 
  • Create clear dashboards and reports so leaders can see participation, capability progress, persistent gaps, and trends across learning programs. 
  • Evaluate learning investments with appropriate assessments and business measures, explain the findings and their limits, and help leaders make informed prioritization and resourcing decisions. 

Content Standards & Management Strategy 

  • Set standards for learning content creation, including clear objectives, instructional design quality, accessibility, scientific accuracy, and subject matter review. 
  • Define a content management strategy for taxonomy, ownership, version control, discoverability, review cadence, archiving, and retirement. 
  • Maintain a curated R&D learning catalog and guide build, buy, reuse, and retirement decisions to reduce duplication and keep resources current. 

Operating Model & Functional Learning Partnership 

  • Design a learning operating model with clear governance, decision rights, service expectations, and ownership across central and functional teams. 
  • Partner with each R&D function to tailor enterprise capability builds to local needs through business consulting, prioritized capability builds, and critical-role consultation. 
  • Treat functional learning partnership as an operating approach, not a separate organization, and clarify ownership with R&D functions and Enterprise partners. 
  • Keep Capability Enablement focused on shared capability strategy, priority learning architecture and experiences, and common standards; functional teams retain ownership of local learning needs and process-specific education.
  • Do not own function-specific competency models for every role, all process learning across R&D, Quality-owned GxP training, employee performance management, or programs that duplicate Enterprise offerings.
  • Present capability and learning analytics to R&D leaders, connecting results to decisions about priorities and investment.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years in learning and development or a related field 
  • Strong expertise in adult learning, instructional design, performance consulting, and digital learning ecosystems. 
  • Experience designing and scaling enterprises or function-wide capability strategies 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10 years in learning, capability, or organizational development, with significant time inside pharma/biotech R&D. 
  • Demonstrated experience designing, owning, or scaling a capability framework across multiple functions. 
  • Experience leading instructional designers or learning design teams and overseeing the quality of a broad learning portfolio. 
  • Experience designing role-based learning journeys, curricula, academies, or development programs for priority capabilities.
  • Experience establishing learning content standards, governance, or a content management strategy. 
  • Experience using learning analytics and evaluation to guide decisions and communicate learning impact to leaders. 
  • Executive-level stakeholder management and comfort presenting learning strategy and findings to senior R&D leaders. 
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a relevant field (organizational psychology, science, or related) preferred. 

Core Competencies 

  • Capability strategy and foresight — connects R&D priorities to current and emerging capability needs. 
  • Instructional design leadership — sets direction, develops designers, and maintains quality across the learning portfolio. 
  • Content strategy and governance — establishes clear creation standards and manages content across its lifecycle. 
  • Learning analytics and impact — interprets evidence and helps leaders use it to guide priorities and investment. 
  • Systems thinking and cross-functional alignment — builds shared approaches that work across R&D functions. 
  • Executive influence and business orientation — connects learning decisions to R&D priorities and outcomes. 

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


The salary range for the position is $192,525 - $260,475 CAD.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.


Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

 

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

raw.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Blurb.fm · Remote (Canada) · Full-Time

THE COMPANY

Who We Are

Blurb builds revenue-generating content products for the most influential media companies in the world. We scale content from what already exists — turning catalogs and brand assets into high performing formats for every major platform.

Our mission is simple: help media companies unlock growth through high volume, high impact content.

THE TEAM

How We Work

We are a nimble, execution obsessed team of engineers who thrive on solving real business problems with smart, scalable solutions. Engineering at Blurb is about building the backbone that powers performant content systems for our clients, not writing speculative code.

We are a small, high trust team. There is no handoff culture here. Every engineer scopes, architects, builds and ships. You will work closely with designers, product, and creative leads and you will own your work end to end.

We care about impact, not just implementation. We engineer with speed, stability and long term adaptability in mind.

THE ROLE

What You Will Do

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a core contributor to the platform that makes content at scale possible. You will architect, build and maintain systems that handle high volume video and content workflows for major media clients.

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role. You will not be managing or delegating, you will be doing. Priority is execution.

In your first 30–60 days

  • Work closely with the team to deeply understand our products, APIs, and infrastructure.

  • Get comfortable in the codebases by shipping bug fixes and small features.

  • Begin identifying areas of improvement in architecture, developer experience, or tooling.

Once you are fully ramped

  • Architect new products and features with stability, flexibility and performance in mind.

  • Own large scale efforts from technical scoping through to production delivery.

  • Lead the development of new tools and production pipelines.

  • Maintain and evolve infrastructure proactively, not just reactively.

  • Ensure quality of all deliverables. Set the bar, then hold it.

  • Contribute ideas that improve how we build and what we build.

This role is NOT right for you if

  • Your best work is coordinating and delegating rather than writing code.

  • You prefer a structured corporate environment with established processes and a full team around you.

  • You expect someone else to resolve ambiguity before you can move.

  • You rely on AI to produce code you do not fully understand or cannot defend.

This is a builder role. You will write code every single day.

﻿

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hard Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful back-end or full-stack ownership.

  • Strong, production-grade TypeScript (Node.js) — this is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • Solid Python skills, especially for data-heavy or ML-adjacent work.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Services (Firebase/Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Compute Engine).

  • Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle: architecture build delivery maintenance.

  • Experience designing and scaling systems for high-volume, performance-sensitive workloads.

  • Comfort working in a Linux environment; Bash/shell scripting is a regular part of the job.

How You Work

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You define requirements when they are unclear instead of waiting for them to be handed to you.

  • You are a self directed executor. You pick up tasks, figure them out and ship without needing to be unblocked at every step.

  • You are comfortable using AI as a productivity multiplier (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) while maintaining your own critical thinking, you architect and analyze code yourself, you do not outsource it.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively across any medium, async messages, docs, code reviews or live calls.

  • You are an advocate for documentation and organized codebases, but pragmatic about what actually gets read and used.

  • You are adaptable. Priorities shift in a startup, you shift with them without losing momentum.

  • You have genuine curiosity about the work: side projects, new tools, emerging patterns in your domain.

Bonus points

  • Experience with video processing, media pipelines, or content-at-scale infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow for ML adjacent tasks.

  • Experience with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or modern React patterns.

  • Prior startup experience — especially as a hands on IC in a small team.

  • Passion for the music or media industry.

THE STACK

Technologies You Will Work With

  • TypeScript (Node.js)
  • Python
  • Google Cloud Services
  • Firebase / Firestore
  • Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
  • Compute Engine
  • Next.js
  • Tailwind CSS
  • PyTorch / TensorFlow
  • Linux
  • Bash / Shell Scripting
  • Adobe After Effects

LIFE AT BLURB

What to Expect

  • Fully remote. We are a distributed team and have been from the start. We have an office in Calgary where you can use.

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy. You will have real influence over how we build and what we build.

  • A small, senior team. No layers, your work ships directly to production and to clients.

  • Fast moving environment. We iterate quickly and expect the same from the people we hire.

We move quickly when we find someone great. If this sounds like the right environment for you, we'd love to hear from you.

At Circet USA, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact by helping to create customized solutions that address our clients' unique challenges. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Circet USA’s benefits package includes the following:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • Short-term & Long-term disability
  • Group term & Voluntary life insurance

  • Company Discount Website

Job Summary and Responsibilities

The JPC Department Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and performance of Joint Pole Committee (JPC) services within the Wireless SoCal department. This position leads department personnel, monitors production and quality, tracks customer and milestone requirements, manages JPA-related documentation and billing activities, prepares customer deliverables, and supports the JPC Director and customer representatives. The role serves as a key point of coordination for Joint Pole Association (JPA) activities, including disputed or denied transactions, committee requirements, and customer reporting.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

  • Perform all duties and responsibilities associated with the JPA Department Manager role and provide subject-matter guidance to department personnel as needed.
  • Manage all JPC services on a day-to-day basis, ensuring department personnel meet required productivity, quality, schedule, documentation, and customer-service expectations.
  • Monitor and record Field Inspector production, output, quality levels, and related performance data; identify trends, deficiencies, and required corrective actions.
  • Track and report monthly production and completion volumes for all applicable milestones and service activities performed by the department.
  • Track additional JPA/JPC requirements, metrics, documentation, and customer-specific activities as requested by the Customer.
  • Prepare, review, and submit required customer deliverables, reports, trackers, supporting documentation, and milestone records accurately and on schedule.
  • Manage Form 44 billing activities in accordance with contract requirements, including validation of supporting documentation, milestone completion, and billing readiness.
  • Support the JPC Director and Customer Representatives with program execution, reporting, issue resolution, escalations, and special requests.
  • Manage JPA denials and maintain complete documentation for contested, disputed, or conflicting JPA transactions; coordinate research, responses, and escalation as required.
  • Attend and/or represent the Customer at applicable JPC meetings, providing project status, documentation, follow-up, and coordination as required.
  • Maintain accurate department records and ensure JPA/JPC activities are documented in applicable customer and internal systems.
  • Coordinate with field personnel, project teams, utilities, Joint Pole Associations/Committees, and customer stakeholders to resolve issues and keep work progressing.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, workload prioritization, coaching, and performance support to assigned department personnel.
  • Identify operational risks, recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, reporting, and customer service.

SAFETY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adhere to, promote, and accept personal responsibility for compliance to:

Federal and Local Occupational Safety and Health Regulations

Industry Consensus Standards

Circet USA Injury and Illness Prevention Program Manual

  • Participate in job site safety/hazard analysis

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Telecommunications, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field; or a minimum of five (5) years of relevant industry experience in lieu of a degree. Relevant experience should include Joint Pole Association (JPA), Joint Pole Committee (JPC), utility, pole attachment, wireless telecommunications, or related infrastructure programs. A minimum of two years of project management, team leadership, or supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of JPA/JPC processes, pole attachment requirements, utility coordination, field inspection activities, milestone tracking, denials, contested transactions, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience managing field personnel, vendors, subcontractors, or multi-functional project teams and holding resources accountable for productivity, quality, schedule, and customer requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret contracts, customer requirements, utility/JPA documentation, billing requirements, technical records, and related project documentation.
  • Experience preparing customer deliverables, production reports, performance metrics, milestone tracking, and documentation used to support billing and program reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and interface with customers, utilities, Joint Pole Associations/Committees, field personnel, project teams, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must possess successful project and process-management experience, including the ability to identify workflow gaps, resolve issues, manage competing priorities, and improve operational efficiency.
